title: Protein Multi-Mutant Stability Ranking
description: An ML surrogate model using XGBoost and Random Forest to predict protein stability changes (ΔΔG), enabling rapid screening of multi-mutant variants relevant to drug discovery and therapeutic development. A genetic algorithm for mutant space exploration outperformed a Monte Carlo baseline by 30% in convergence speed, validated with a batched FoldX physics-based structural verification pipeline.
